signature.what: every line starting `**Signed by Sergi:` in PLAN_CORRECTIONS.md, of which there must be at least 1. A gate that stopped at the first would report ok over an unsigned amendment.

provenance: POST-RUN: proposed by the agent and asked for by Sergi on 2026-11-15, after corrections/conditions.py. The expectation in the module's docstring was written and committed before the reading ran. Not a signed row; no verdict moves.
added_after_the_first_run: Added after the first run, after its seven clauses were read: for every rule that takes a queue's points, the rule that had decided its ticket at a reported error, and the edges between it and the queue's rules, those its own answer declared at its birth and those later rules of the queue declared against it, each with the engine's verdict; and the points each replay turns right, split by the way the record's final base lost them. Both tried in a scratch script first. No expectation; no clause moves.

expectation.what: at least half of the queue's points lost at the peak are contested conflicts
at least half of the queue's points lost before the peak are outranked
at least half of the queue's outranked points are outranked by an edge
at least half of the queue's taken points are decided only by rules born at a reported error
at least half of the queue's taken points are decided only by rules born at tickets H06, H07 or H08 governs
installed losses first, the replay gives back at least half as many of the queue's points as were lost at the peak
at least half of SECURITY_INCIDENT's points lost before the peak are decided by T2_TECHNICAL
